title: api-gateway: routing rules, payload limits, and streaming proxy buffer improvements
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Improves API gateway routing and streaming reliability: enforces route-aware payload limits, reduces streaming proxy memory growth via buffer tuning and backpressure, fixes OpenAI-compat function-calling edge cases caused by payload truncation.
description: Motivation: we've observed production incidents where large chat sessions proxied through the API gateway to streaming backends cause excessive memory growth and intermittent latency spikes (INC-2026-02). Additionally, the OpenAI-compat layer behaved inconsistently for function/tool-calling payloads when gateway-level truncation or buffering occurred, resulting in malformed function call payloads and downstream parser errors. This PR applies targeted performance and correctness fixes at the gateway surface: 1) route-aware payload size enforcement - certain public endpoints have stricter JSON/body size limits while internal trust routes retain higher caps; 2) streaming proxy buffer tuning - reduce default per-connection buffer high-water marks and enable adaptive backpressure to avoid unbounded queueing; 3) streaming header pass-through adjustments - only a whitelisted subset of headers are forwarded to reduce header bloat impacting proxy memory; 4) OpenAI compatibility fixes - ensure function call events and structured output chunks are reassembled with content-length awareness and safe truncation semantics; 5) observability - new metrics for gateway_buffer_queue_size, route_payload_dropped, and streaming_backpressure_events plus alert thresholds. Changes include config knobs (gateway.route.payload_limit, gateway.proxy.buffer_high, gateway.proxy.buffer_low, gateway.compat.truncate_mode) with sensible defaults. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for buffer logic - [x] Integration e2e (chat + function calling) - [x] Load test with representative traffic - [x] Docs snippet for new gateway config - [x] Linear tickets linked. Impact: backward-compatible behavior for most routes; default payload limits tightened for public endpoints to prevent resource exhaustion. Operations: rolling deploy safe (config defaults), feature gated behind feature flag gateway.alloc_tuning for quick rollback. See linked linear tickets for rollout plan.

discussion_summary: This PR tightens gateway routing and streaming proxy behavior to prevent memory/latency incidents while preserving OpenAI compatibility for function/tool calls. Reviewers requested extra metrics and tests; those were added. CI required a single e2e rerun due to a flaky network test. Ops rollout will be controlled via a feature flag and helm values for canary percentage.
notes_for_ops: Default payload_limit reduced for public routes; if customers hit regressions, toggle gateway.alloc_tuning=false and bump gateway.proxy.buffer_high temporarily. Helm chart values updated at redwood/helm-charts/gateway/values.yaml. Coordinate canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours with monitoring on gateway_buffer_queue_size and route_payload_dropped.
